notes.title: Jump into Chomp City Arena and be the LAST PAC STANDING!
notes.content:
[h2]Everything except the maze is edible in [b]PAC-MAN MEGA TUNNEL BATTLE: CHOMP CHAMPS[/b], where players chomp their way through pellets, power-ups, GHOSTS, and even other PACs across multiple interconnected mazes to become the Chomp Champ – a.k.a. the last PAC standing at the end of each match. [/h2]

[previewyoutube=hCym2OJrF08;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Available now![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095950/PACMAN_Mega_Tunnel_Battle_Chomp_Champs/

notes.title: Chomp everything in sight in PAC-MAN MEGA TUNNEL BATTLE: CHOMP CHAMPS
notes.content:
[h3][b]PAC-MAN MEGA TUNNEL BATTLE: CHOMP CHAMPS[/b] is a raucous take on PAC-MAN multiplayer, featuring cross-play for the first time and amping up gameplay with:
[list][*] 64-player battles
[*]A variety of colourful interconnected mazes
[*]Customizable PACs
[*]Power Items that not only boost players’ abilities...
[*]...but can also help the GHOSTS chase down the competition[/list]
The game is [b]available now for preorder[/b] in Standard and Deluxe editions, with all preorders receiving the [b]Chomp Challengers Pac Preorder bonus[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=7J089XoFDfE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Coming May 9th, 2024 on Steam![/b][/h2]
